---
title: "The Speeches of Hamlet"
description: |
   This is a full text analysis project using dialogue from Shakespeare's play Hamlet. I analyze character strings to answer the following 2 research questions:


   1. Who is the biggest yapper (i.e. who talks the most) in Hamlet?
   2. How does language about love compare to language about death?
